name: Aviary
desc:
PART-TIME : Patient Engagement Specialist | $25.00/hr base + bonuses ($30-$35/hr with the expected bonuses) | Outbound Phone Heavy, Retention Focus 

What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Aviary Health is a venture-backed virtual cardiac rehabilitation company. Their intensive cardiac rehab program works only when patients keep showing up, so this role exists to make sure they do. Your day is primarily outbound calls to patients who have missed sessions, gone quiet, or expressed a desire to leave the program, with the goal of getting them re-engaged and back to their next appointment.
 Key responsibilities from the posting:
Own retention for your assigned patient panel, proactively reaching out before patients fall off
Recover no-shows and missed sessions by rescheduling within 48 hours wherever possible
Re-engage patients who have missed consecutive sessions
Save patients who ask to discontinue by uncovering the real reason and resolving it
Handle inbound calls and messages, resolving scheduling and access issues on first contact
Educate patients on the program and the Aviary Health app
Troubleshoot Zoom and device issues so patients can actually attend their sessions
Document all interactions and surface patterns to the Clinical Operations team
This is a phone-heavy, performance-tracked retention role. A working, reliable cell phone line is required to make and receive calls, with a VOIP application provided by Aviary. Most of your time is spent on calls with patients who are older adults navigating a serious heart condition, which requires both sales skill and genuine care in how you communicate.
assessment: Expect an assessment and interview heavy about sports, apps, fantasy leagues
wage: $25.00/hr base plus performance bonuses. On-target earnings of $30-$35/hr.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Experience in lieu of education.
 Required Experience: 2+ years in sales, retention, account management, or a save-desk environment with demonstrated objection handling and target achievement.
 Preferred Experience:
Healthcare-adjacent experience such as telehealth, medical device, pharma, health insurance, or patient services
Demonstrated success specifically in retention, save/win-back, or outbound patient engagement
 Required Skills:
Strong objection handling and the ability to find and resolve the real concern quickly
Relentless follow-up and urgency in recovering lapsed patients
Excellent verbal communication with healthcare patients, including older adults
Comfort with CRM and ticketing systems, scheduling tools, and basic tech troubleshooting on Apple and Android devices
Strong time management and prioritization across a panel of active patients
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with 2+ years of phone-based retention, save-desk, or patient engagement experience who is motivated by performance-based pay
People who genuinely care about helping patients stay with a program that could improve their health outcomes
Participants comfortable with an evening-extended availability window and an every-other-Saturday commitment
Anyone with healthcare or telehealth background who wants to combine patient care with performance-driven work
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who needs a fixed, predictable schedule without evening availability
Participants who are uncomfortable with outbound calling and objection-based conversations
Anyone who prefers low-volume, steady-pace work over a high-urgency, metrics-driven daily environment
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Patient retention
Outbound engagement
Objection handling
Cardiac rehabilitation
Telehealth patient support
Save desk
Win-back campaigns
Patient re-engagement
Healthcare CRM
Performance-based patient outreach
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 No detailed hiring process data found specific to this role. As a fast-growing startup, expect a recruiter or hiring manager conversation focused on your retention and objection-handling background, with the process likely moving quickly given the company's stated growth pace.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Walk me through how you would handle a patient who says they want to quit the program because they don't see any benefit.
How do you prioritize your outreach when you have a large panel of at-risk patients and limited hours in the day?
Tell me about a time you saved an account or re-engaged a customer who had already mentally checked out.
How do you adjust your communication approach when speaking with an older adult who is dealing with a serious health issue?
other:
Aviary Health is a small, well-funded startup that is doubling its member base monthly. That growth pace is exciting but also means processes, expectations, and team structures are evolving quickly. Participants should be comfortable with some ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
The patient population here is specifically cardiac rehab patients, which skews older and often means people dealing with a significant health scare. The combination of sales skill and emotional intelligence required is higher than a typical retention role. This is not a fit for someone who can handle objections but lacks patience or empathy with vulnerable callers.
The every-other-Saturday commitment and wide daily hours window are worth confirming as a lifestyle fit before applying.
Career Pathway: Patient Engagement Specialist → Senior Engagement Specialist → Engagement Team Lead → Patient Operations Manager → Director of Patient Engagement
